::: {#sol-empty-domain}

$\forall x \in \emptyset, x > 5$ is true.
It would be false only if some element of $\emptyset$ were not greater than $5$,
and $\emptyset$ has no elements.
A universal statement about an empty domain is called **vacuously true**.

$\exists x \in \emptyset, x > 5$ is false,
since $\emptyset$ has no element at all, let alone one greater than $5$.

Racket agrees:
`(andmap positive? '())` returns `#t`,
and `(ormap positive? '())` returns `#f`.

:::
